annotations.title: Check work and get a signed stamp

description: Use before you hand over a report, calculation, summary or filing draft you are not fully sure of: separate code checks it and returns a signed pass, fail or inconclusive stamp saying exactly what is wrong. Free daily limit. Example: {"output": "12 invoices at $40 each: 12 * 40 = 480", "producer": {"agent_id": "my-agent"}, "kind": "calculation"} Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key>. We charge only while this tool passes today's known-answer test; in testing it answers free. Docs: https://llpro.ai/countersign

claims.description: Optional explicit items: {type:'arithmetic', expression, claimed} or {type:'quote', source_url, quote} or {type:'value', source_url, value}

language.description: For code: python or json get a syntax check

output.description: The work to check, as text (max 100000 chars). Equations written as '12 * 4 = 48' are re-computed.

private.description: If true the public log shows only a hash of each finding's detail; you still get the full detail

producer.description: Who made the work: {agent_id, model}. Required; used for the independence rule.

name: countersign_stamp
